description: Complete a payment that Claude's computer use session has identified on screen — a checkout form, wire transfer UI, invoice approval, or vendor portal payment step. Call this instead of typing card/bank details into a UI. Describe what you see on screen, provide the amount and recipient, and DPX runs the full oracle gate → compliance screen → settlement flow. Returns a receipt with settlement ID. The human stays out of the loop. Use this whenever computer use encounters a payment that would otherwise require human re-entry of credentials or approval.

amount.description: Payment amount in USD as shown on screen

counterparty_name.description: Vendor or payee name as shown on screen — used for compliance screen

purpose.description: Payment purpose — e.g. vendor-invoice, contractor-payment, subscription, procurement

recipient_address.description: Recipient wallet address (0x...). If only a bank account or email is visible, use settlement.nl instead with the full instruction.

sandbox.description: Set false for live execution. Default: true

screen_context.description: Describe what is visible on screen — the payment form, vendor name, invoice number, or UI context. Used for audit trail.

name: computer_use.pay
